notablePrerequisites: Soul Diviner does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Dire Fleet Hoarder.
Dire Fleet Hoarder and Luminous Broodmoth triggers.
Resolve the Dire Fleet Hoarder triggers, creating a treasure token.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Dire Fleet Hoarder to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Sorched Rusalka trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it, removing a flying counter from Dire Fleet Hoarder.
Repeat.
